# The small-SaaS stack you can host yourself.

> 28 open-source, self-hosted tools that replace the small-SaaS subscriptions a founder pays for: booking, help center, error tracking, feature flags, analytics, email, referrals, billing metrics and e-signature. MIT licensed, zero dependencies, one-click deploy.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
